# Nevatal Cloud

> Minimalist bare-metal cloud compute, managed game servers, Waydroid Android containers, and AI Cloud Agent powered by Proxmox VE 8 and Dell PowerEdge R640 bare-metal nodes.

Nevatal Cloud abstracts enterprise virtualization into a developer-friendly web control plane and REST API (/api/v1). It automates cloud-init OS provisioning, multi-tenant network isolation, S3-compatible object storage, game servers (Minecraft Java & Bedrock, Terraria), and Waydroid Android containers with browser WebRTC streaming in under 30 seconds.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://cloud.nevatal.id/): Cloud platform overview, architecture, and deployment options
- [Documentation](https://cloud.nevatal.id/docs): Documentation index and guides
- [Sitemap](https://cloud.nevatal.id/sitemap.xml): XML index of all public URLs
- [Full Text Documentation Corpus](https://cloud.nevatal.id/llms-full.txt): Complete text documentation for LLMs and AI agents

## Documentation Guides

### Compute & Virtual Machines
- [Platform Overview](https://cloud.nevatal.id/docs/overview): Architecture, hardware cluster, and core capabilities
- [Quickstart Guide](https://cloud.nevatal.id/docs/quickstart): Deploy a virtual machine in under 30 seconds
- [Hardware & Infrastructure](https://cloud.nevatal.id/docs/architecture): Dell PowerEdge R640 hypervisors and NVMe ZFS pools
- [Virtual Instances](https://cloud.nevatal.id/docs/instances): KVM VM management, resizing, snapshots, and power states
- [Cloud-Init & SSH Automation](https://cloud.nevatal.id/docs/cloud-init): Automated bootstrapping, user setup, and SSH key injection
- [WordPress LEMP Stack](https://cloud.nevatal.id/docs/wordpress-lemp): Nginx, PHP 8.3-FPM, and MariaDB ready-to-run appliance
- [Networking & Firewall](https://cloud.nevatal.id/docs/console-networking): Network bridges, dedicated IPs, and firewall security

### Managed Game Servers
- [Minecraft Java Edition](https://cloud.nevatal.id/docs/minecraft-java): Paper, Purpur, Fabric, and Forge server hosting
- [Minecraft Bedrock Edition](https://cloud.nevatal.id/docs/minecraft-bedrock): High-performance mobile and cross-play server runtime
- [Terraria Dedicated Servers](https://cloud.nevatal.id/docs/terraria): Re-Logic 2D action-adventure world server with tModLoader
- [Game Backups & Snapshots](https://cloud.nevatal.id/docs/game-backups): Instant NVMe ZFS snapshots and S3 cloud archives

### Android Cloud (Waydroid)
- [Waydroid Android Overview](https://cloud.nevatal.id/docs/android-overview): Unmodified Android 11/13 in containerized Linux namespaces
- [Browser Interactive Streaming](https://cloud.nevatal.id/docs/android-streaming): 60 FPS WebRTC streaming with touch, mouse, and audio
- [Network ADB & APK Deployment](https://cloud.nevatal.id/docs/adb-apps): Port 5555 remote debugging, testing, and APK installation

### App Hosting & Automation
- [Git Continuous Deployment](https://cloud.nevatal.id/docs/git-deploy): Automated builds and deployments for Node.js, Python, and Go
- [n8n Workflow Automation](https://cloud.nevatal.id/docs/n8n-automation): 400+ SaaS connectors, webhooks, and visual event automation
- [OpenClaw Personal AI](https://cloud.nevatal.id/docs/openclaw-agents): Autonomous AI agent daemon deployed alongside workloads

### Object Storage & APIs
- [S3 Object Storage](https://cloud.nevatal.id/docs/s3-storage): MinIO S3-compatible buckets, file browser, and access keys
- [REST API Reference](https://cloud.nevatal.id/docs/rest-api): Versioned v1 REST API, JWT authentication, and examples
- [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://cloud.nevatal.id/docs/mcp-protocol): Connect Claude Desktop and Cursor directly to Nevatal Cloud

### Hypervisor Administration
- [Proxmox VE Setup](https://cloud.nevatal.id/docs/proxmox-setup): Proxmox VE 8 cluster configuration and API credentials
- [Cloud-Init Template Library](https://cloud.nevatal.id/docs/cloudinit-templates): Standardizing Ubuntu, Debian, and Alpine templates
- [ISO Media Catalog](https://cloud.nevatal.id/docs/iso-catalog): Managing custom operating system install ISOs

- [AI Catalog](https://cloud.nevatal.id/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): Catalog of AI endpoints, MCP servers, and interfaces
- [MCP Server Card](https://cloud.nevatal.id/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): Model Context Protocol definition
- [Agent Skills Index](https://cloud.nevatal.id/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): Skills registry for autonomous coding agents
- [Nevatal Cloud Skill](https://cloud.nevatal.id/.well-known/agent-skills/nevatal-cloud/SKILL.md): Comprehensive instructions for AI agent pairing
- [API Catalog](https://cloud.nevatal.id/.well-known/api-catalog): Index of versioned REST API routes
